NGA.note: Only NITDA's internal AI guideline and ethics risks for its own use; no rule on AI harms.

facts.fact: Nigeria's NITDA states in its March 2025 roadmap that it is developing an AI-powered Knowledge Management System to guide staff through agency processes, with ML document routing, generative-AI rule drafting and agentic coordination planned over 18 months.

NGA.note: NITDA's plan covers its own regulatory and internal operations, not a sector system.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in the country is stated.
NITDA says it implemented a Power Automate mail-routing workflow but does not say its own staff built or run it.
